name: Nachos Supreme
steps: Spread chips on a tray|Cover with cheese|Bake until melted|Top with jalapeños, sour cream, and salsa

name: Veggie Stir Fry
steps: Cook rice|Chop all vegetables|Stir fry veg with garlic|Add soy sauce|Serve over rice

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Boil spaghetti|Brown the beef with onion and garlic|Add tomato sauce and simmer|Combine and top with parmesan

name: Overnight Oats
steps: Combine oats, milk, honey, and chia seeds in a jar|Stir well|Refrigerate overnight|Top with blueberries before serving

name: Grilled Cheese
steps: Butter the bread|Place cheese between slices|Grill until golden on both sides
